verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a cloud storage service with a developer API, so the axis applies. Direct probes returned HTTP 404 for llms.txt, for the markdown version of the OneDrive docs page, and for every OpenAPI candidate path. The pack contains only conventional Graph API documentation, with no agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
